factionRules.name: Elite Fieldcraft
factionRules.timing: Ready Step and enemy operative activations
factionRules.text: In each Ready Step, gain 1 Fieldcraft point, or 2 if a friendly Spectre Squad Vox-Operator is in the killzone and outside enemy control range. Discard all Fieldcraft points at the end of the turning point. After an Engage-order enemy performs an action during its activation, spend 1 point to interrupt once with a ready friendly operative outside all other enemy control ranges; it can perform a free Shoot (not Guard), Dash, or Reposition. Each friendly operative can gain only one such free action per turning point. Apply all target, order, point-blank shot, movement, drop-zone, Wall, and teleport restrictions from the faction rule on the tabletop.

factionRules.name: Camo Cloaks
factionRules.timing: When an enemy shoots a friendly operative
factionRules.text: When retaining cover saves for a friendly Spectre Squad operative other than the Vox-Relay Beacon, retain one additional cover save or retain one cover save as a critical success. This is not cumulative with improved cover saves from Vantage terrain.

abilities.name: Issue Mission (0AP)
abilities.text: Select one eligible expended friendly Spectre Squad operative visible to the Veteran Sergeant that has not used Elite Fieldcraft to interrupt this turning point. It can interrupt despite being expended, but then cannot counteract this turning point or Reposition if it already did so. The Sergeant cannot perform this action within enemy control range.

abilities.name: Pre-Deploy
abilities.text: During Set Up Operatives, this operative can be set up outside the drop zone, wholly within your territory and more than 2" from markers and equipment terrain features.

abilities.name: Expendable
abilities.text: Can only perform Signal; cannot counteract, retaliate, assist, contest, or count for the specified kill, escape, survival, incapacitation, victory, or VP conditions. Operatives can move through it and the opponent can ignore its control range; apply the full datacard guidance.

abilities.name: Signal (1AP)
abilities.text: Select one other friendly Spectre Squad operative within 6". Until the end of its next activation, add 1 to its APL. Cannot be performed within enemy control range.

abilities.name: Medic!
abilities.text: Once per turning point, when another eligible visible friendly operative within 3" would be incapacitated, it can remain on 1 wound and Dash into the medic’s control range; apply the APL penalties, activation ending, targeting, and control-range restrictions on the tabletop.

abilities.name: Medikit (0AP)
abilities.text: An eligible friendly operative in control range regains up to 2D3 lost wounds. It cannot be an operative Medic! was used on this turning point. Cannot be performed within enemy control range.

abilities.name: Grenadier
abilities.text: Can use frag, krak and smoke grenades without counting toward equipment limited uses. Improve Hit by 1 with frag or krak grenades.

abilities.name: Melta Mine
abilities.text: Carries the Melta Mine marker; can Pick Up Marker and can Dash free after Place Marker, subject to the placement restrictions.

abilities.name: Proximity Mine
abilities.text: When the Melta Mine marker first enters another operative’s control range, remove it and inflict 2D6+3 damage; end that operative’s action if it survives. Resolve placement and damage manually.

abilities.name: Prepared Killzone
abilities.text: Select one additional equipment option; it must be an Ammo Cache or equipment terrain feature.

abilities.name: Scout Terrain
